analyst_view.overall: Early view: Goztepe (10th) won four league games in a row, including 2-1 at Fenerbahce, before Basaksehir beat them 2-1 in Izmir. Promoted Erzurumspor (12th) under Serkan Ozbalta have lost their last two, 3-1 at home to Corum and 2-1 at Rizespor, and have scored only ten goals in eleven games. This is a first read and will be updated with team news, which is thin for both sides so far.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals and I lean slightly higher. Goztepe's eleven games have produced 41 goals, with Juan, Henrique and Armstrong all scoring recently, and Erzurumspor conceded three at home to Corum in their last home match.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.2 corners. Neither side's recent games point to a big change, and with Erzurumspor likely to sit in against an in-form visitor, I keep it close to eight.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.9 cards. Nothing specific moves this: no suspensions are reported on either side and there is no rivalry to speak of, so around four looks fair until the referee is named.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.1 shots, with Goztepe taking slightly more. That suits a game where Goztepe's attack meets a home side that has been leaking chances, so I stay with the number.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.5 shots on target. I lean a little higher in line with goals: Goztepe have scored 22 in eleven and Erzurumspor have conceded 17, so the visitors in particular should test the keeper often.
